# RedirectCMS – AI guide
- Stack: plain PHP 8.1+ (no Composer/framework). DB config lives in config/config.php (fallback to example_config.php). PDO only; keep connection via Database.php.
- Writable dirs: storage/logs, storage/cache, storage/locks, uploads. Do not move index.php into subfolders; basePath is derived from SCRIPT_NAME.
- Public router (index.php): handles /__event (logs click/redirect via EventRepository), /blog/{slug} (blog post via LinkRepository::getBySlugWithRelations, ThemeManager templates), home (/ with home_mode landing/blog/redirect), and slug redirect with password protection, delayed redirect, OG metadata and social-bot bypass (Utils::isSocialCrawler).
- Admin router (admin/index.php): switch on ?action=..., calls AdminController methods; Utils::requireLogin guards most actions. New admin actions should be wired in this switch + implemented as methods rendering admin/*.php views through AdminController::view().
- Settings: key-value in table settings; access via SettingsRepository::get/set. Branding assets (logo/favicon), home_* content, blog_theme, cron toggles live here.
- Links: LinkRepository covers CRUD, listing with pagination/filter by category/tag, custom fields (link_custom_fields), gallery images (link_images), publish_at/expires_at, password protection. Use Utils::sanitizeSlug/sanitizeUrl before writes.
- Tags/categories: CategoryRepository/TagRepository back link_tags join; list filters in blog mode use ?category=slug/?tag=slug with lookups in those repos.
- Stats: StatsRepository::recordClick anonymizes IP (Utils::anonymizeIp), geo lookup via Utils::getGeoLocation (ip-api) with 30-day geo_cache table. Global stats cached in global_stats_cache (TTL 30 min) for 6 combos (days 7/30/90 x excludeBots flag); admin global_stats page refreshes cache with loader and button.
- Pseudo-cron: index.php runs PseudoCron::tick() every request. Jobs stored in cron_jobs/cron_logs, locks in storage/locks, max task 30s. Default callbacks in CronTasks: cleanGeoCache (geo_cache trim), refreshGlobalStatsCache (all cache variants), cleanCronLogs, cleanOldEvents, cleanOrphanUploads. Register defaults via admin?action=cron_register_defaults.
- CLI helpers: scripts/clean_geo_cache.php (delete geo_cache entries older than N days or --clear-all, logs to storage/logs/geo_cache.log) and scripts/refresh_global_stats_cache.php (rebuild all global stats caches; intended for real cron). Both load DB config the same way as web.
- Image handling: ImageUploader uploads to uploads/ with thumbnails; AdminController::uploadImageAjax manages whitelist in session to allow later deletion; paths must stay under uploads/ and not contain ..; cleanOrphanUploads cron removes unreferenced files.
- Security conventions: use Utils::csrfToken/verifyCsrf on admin forms and Ajax; Utils::startSession required before session use (AdminController does it); Utils::sanitizeHtml strips dangerous tags. Do not bypass Utils::requireLogin for admin actions. Passwords stored as hashes in settings (admin) and links (per-link protection).
- Theming/blog: ThemeManager loads templates/{theme}/{home|post}.php; safe theme name enforced. Blog description length/posts per page controlled by settings; related posts gathered by LinkRepository::getRelatedPosts.
- Debugging/logs: admin/index.php enables error display by default; runtime logs in storage/logs/cron.log and geo_cache.log. Stats cache TTL or pseudo-cron issues usually surface there.
- No automated tests/build; verify changes through admin dashboard pages, public redirect flow, and cron jobs (check locks/logs). Default admin login admin/admin if settings empty—change via settings page.
